headline: Binance withdrawals are partly back and about $2B left the exchange in three hours; its full reserves proof is now expected by Tuesday 3 Nov.

stories.title: Binance reopens withdrawals in phases; about $2B leaves in three hours
stories.summary: After the roughly $6.3B hack, Binance ran phase one of withdrawals on Sunday, starting with Bitcoin, then ETH and the big stablecoins. About $2B left in the first three hours, per Whale Alert. The full Proof of Reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is now expected by Tuesday 3 Nov, a day later than first promised.
points: Phase one was set for 06:00-09:00 UTC on 1 Nov and covers BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB and XRP plus assets on 15 other blockchains, per CoinDesk.
ETH, USDT and USDC on Ethereum and BNB, USDT and USDC on BNB Smart Chain have reopened, per crypto.news.
About $2B left Binance within three hours of reopening, including 10,000 BTC and nearly $1B of USDT, per Whale Alert via The Currency Analytics.
Binance says it has replaced about 95% of affected assets with company funds, up from 90% a day earlier, and that losses will not be passed on to users, per CoinDesk. These are Binance's own figures.
The zero-knowledge reserves proof takes 40-50 hours to compute and is expected by Tue 3 Nov (UTC), per tech-ish; Binance had promised it by Monday.

stories.title: FBI names North Korea; stolen funds laundered 'on autopilot'
stories.summary: The FBI says North Korea's TraderTraitor group stole more than $6B and is converting it mainly into ETH. Blockchain analysts see automated laundering, and about $3B, mostly stablecoins, has been frozen. Bitcoin and ETH cannot be frozen the same way.
points: The FBI alert names TraderTraitor for "the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets", being converted "primarily into Ethereum (ETH)", per tech-ish.
About $3B is frozen, mostly USDT and USDC that issuers can freeze, per CoinDesk; Elliptic put verified frozen funds at $2.84B.
Elliptic says the main Tron distribution wallet "has sent funds every hour for 31 hours straight", and puts the stolen total at about $6.43B.
Trump, asked about the hack on 31 Oct, said "We're looking into it. I'm not worried," per crypto.news.

stories.title: Bitcoin's worst October since 2014 hands off to midterm week
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell about 7.7% in October amid a tech-stock sell-off and the Binance hack, and traded in a narrow range on Sunday. Tuesday's US midterms shape who writes crypto market rules, with the CLARITY Act stuck in the Senate.
points: Bitcoin was on track for its worst October since 2014 as of 30 Oct, per CoinGlass data cited by Cointelegraph.
CryptoTicker had October closing at $77,223, down 7.67% on the month, and only $656 between bitcoin's high and low over the 24 hours to Sunday morning, the tightest range since 17 Oct.
Crypto groups spent about $176M across more than 100 races, per Reuters via the Motley Fool.
The CLARITY Act failed a Senate cloture vote on 15 Sep with 49 of the 60 votes needed, per the Motley Fool.

briefs.title: Expect slow withdrawals
briefs.summary: Binance warned of congestion and told users whose withdrawal fails to "try again after a short while", per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Binance refilling its SAFU fund
briefs.summary: Binance plans to refill its emergency fund to about $1B; the 95% figure means replaced assets, not recovered stolen funds, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Moscow Exchange to list crypto
briefs.summary: The Moscow Exchange plans BTC, ETH and USDT trading from 1 Dec, with limits for retail investors, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: 3x crypto ETFs pushed back
briefs.summary: GraniteShares moved the planned effective date for its 3x BTC, XRP, ETH and SOL ETFs to 30 Nov, per Coinpedia.
